tools.name: fetch_flowie_page
tools.description: Return the clean Markdown of a single get-flowie.com page. Pass a path like '/platform/ai-agents' or '/e-invoicing/france' (or a full https://get-flowie.com/... URL). Use after search_flowie to read a page's full content cheaply.

tools.name: get_flowie_overview
tools.description: Return a canonical, citable summary of what Flowie is — positioning, key capabilities, compliance coverage, pricing model, and the most useful entry-point URLs. Takes no arguments. Use when asked 'what is Flowie' or for a grounded company/product overview.
